meta.display: The Three Barrels — TavernSim v0 slice
meta.notes: Phase-0 setting as data, per docs/MVP_SCOPE.md §4 (that table is the source of truth for ids, counts and roles). Every value NOT pinned by MVP_SCOPE is a v0.1 tunable default: pack data, not law — retuning is a pack change, never a code change (INV-3). Display names in English (D-009). iter-20: locations carry a `layout` field — static architecture as canon-from-birth pack data (rendered on the brief scene line via rules.json brief.present_entities.scene_line_fields, D-057; the gateway's canon_slot check guards it like every pack-modeled field, KI#48).
